SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE

Date 7 / 12 / 33

Confidential

December 7 3.

Consul-General for Netherlands,
Shanghai.

Sir,

I have the honour to refer to your letter
No. 3549 of November 29 and to state that the
International Intelligence Service, 1342 North Szechuen
Road, was established in October 1933. It consists of
an advertising agency, news agency and private detective
bureau, and there is nothing unfavourable known about it.

The principal director of the International
Intelligence Service is named Wu Ping Yat (伍平一) alias
Wu Sung Yu (伍澄宇). He is a lawyer by profession
and in October 1933 was suspended from membership of the
Chinese Bar Association for a year in connection with
irregularities concerning certain funds which he had
received on behalf of one of his clients. Wu Ping Yat
is a native of Kwangtung and was educated in Japan.
He was formerly the General Director of the International
Event, a service bureau similar to the International
Intelligence Service which closed down in 1929.

The member of the staff of the International
Intelligence Service next in importance to Wu Ping Yat
alias Wu Sung Yu is named Theodore Haito Kwan (關海濤),
B.A. He was born in Hongkong of Cantonese parents, and

国际情报社的主要负责人名为伍平一（Wu Ping Yat），别名伍澄宇（Wu Sung Yu）。其职业为律师，1933年10月，因涉及在其代表一名客户收取的某些款项中存在违规行为，被中华民国律师公会暂停会员资格一年。伍平一系广东人，曾留学日本。他此前曾任“国际事件社”（International Event）总经理，该服务局性质与国际情报社类似，于1929年停业。

国际情报社职员中地位仅次于伍平一（别名伍澄宇）者，名为關海濤（Theodore Haito Kwan），文学士。他出生于香港，父母均为广东人，且

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE

Date December 5, 1933

Subject (in full) International Intelligence Service.

Made by D.S. Sansom Forwarded by W. Lourenço D.S.P.

With reference to the Netherlands Consul-General's
enquiry as to whether anything unfavourable is known regarding
the International Intelligence Service or its management, I
have to report as follows :-

The International Intelligence Service, 1342 North
Szechuen Road, was established in October 1933 and is a
combination of an advertising agency, home and abroad news
agency and a private detective bureau. It is understood
that the organization will be registered with the British
Consulate. Its management consists of :-

1) Wu Ping Yat (伍平一), alias Wu Sung Yu (伍澄宇),
the general director. He is a Cantonese and was
educated in Japan. In 1928 he was the general director
of the International Event, a service bureau similar
in character to the International Intelligence Service,
and which voluntarily closed down in 1929. He is
a qualified lawyer but was suspended during October,
1933 by the Chinese Bar Association for a period of one
year. The reasons for the suspension are that Mr. Yat
is alleged to have misappropriated certain funds
recovered on behalf of a female claimant without recourse
to court action. Claimant subsequently instituted a
law suit against Mr. Yat with the result that he was
suspended in accordance with the rules of the Chinese
Bar Association. It is understood that judgement on
the law suit has not yet been given.

2) Theodore Haito Kwan, B.A. (關海濤), an assistant
director. He was born at Hongkong of Cantonese descent
and is a registered British subject. Received his

关于荷兰总领事询问是否知悉有关国际情报社或其管理层任何不利情况一事，现报告如下：

位于北四川路1342号的国际情报社成立于1933年10月，是集广告代理、国内外新闻通讯社及私人侦探社于一体的机构。据悉，该组织将在英国领事馆注册。其管理层成员包括：

1) 伍平一（Wu Ping Yat），别名伍澄宇（Wu Sung Yu），总经理。他是广东人，曾留学日本。1928年，他曾担任“国际事件社”总经理，该服务局性质与国际情报社类似，并于1929年自愿停业。他具备律师资格，但于1933年10月被中华民国律师公会暂停执业一年。暂停执业的原因是，据称伍平一先生在未经诉讼程序的情况下，挪用了为一名女性索赔人追回的某些款项。随后，该索赔人对伍平一先生提起诉讼，结果导致其根据中华民国律师公会规则被暂停执业。据悉，该诉讼尚未宣判。

2) 關海濤（Theodore Haito Kwan），文学士，副总经理。他出生于香港，系广东裔，注册为英国臣民。他在
